main.description: A thread: a titled conversation inside a channel, board or other container. Baseline metadata shared across group-chat and forum apps; each app keeps its native thread record and content alongside it. The record lives where the hosting app keeps threads: the author's repo (forums) or the community's repo or space (group chat).

container.description: Where the thread lives: an at:// URI of a channel or board record, a space reference, or an https URL. Moving the thread rewrites this field.

author.description: Who opened the thread. Required in practice when the record is written by someone else on the author's behalf (for example a community account); otherwise the repo owner is the author.

url.description: Canonical web address where the thread can be read in the hosting app.

origin.description: The message the thread was branched from, if any (a chat thread opened from a message).

textContent.description: Plain-text rendering of the thread's opening post, without markup, for previews, search and apps that cannot render 'content'.

content.description: The opening post in an app-native format. Open union: each app supplies its own $type (for example a list of atmoBB rich-text blocks).

locked.description: Whether only moderators may add posts. Absent means unlocked.

closedAt.description: When the thread was closed or resolved. Absent means open. Apps decide whether a closed thread still accepts posts.

updatedAt.description: When the title or opening post was last edited. Absent means never edited.
